title.zh: Ripple与多家机构建立基础设施合作并获OCC批准设立国家信托银行
title.en: Ripple forms infrastructure partnerships with multiple institutions

current_state.zh: 美国 OCC 正式批准 Ripple National Trust Bank，据 CEO Brad Garlinghouse 称，这将使 Ripple 能够支持其 RLUSD 稳定币，并通过受联邦监管的银行平台提供企业级数字资产托管服务。
current_state.en: The U.S. OCC formally approved Ripple National Trust Bank, letting Ripple support its RLUSD stablecoin and offer enterprise digital asset custody through a federally regulated banking platform, according to CEO Brad Garlinghouse.

updates.title_zh: 渣打银行新增Ripple USD托管服务，并着眼与LMAX的抵押品协议
updates.title_en: Standard Chartered adds Ripple USD custody, eyes LMAX collateral deal
updates.what_changed_zh: 渣打银行已在XRP Ledger上为Ripple的RLUSD稳定币推出机构托管服务，并计划将其抵押品镜像模式扩展至LMAX Group，使机构能够将RLUSD作为交易抵押品，同时资产仍由该银行托管。
updates.what_changed_en: Standard Chartered has rolled out institutional custody for Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin on the XRP Ledger and plans to extend its collateral-mirroring model to LMAX Group so institutions can post RLUSD as trading collateral while assets remain in the bank's custody.
updates.current_state_zh: 渣打银行已在XRP Ledger上为Ripple的RLUSD稳定币推出机构托管服务，并计划将其抵押品镜像模式扩展至LMAX Group，使机构能够将RLUSD作为交易抵押品，同时资产仍由该银行托管。
updates.current_state_en: Standard Chartered has rolled out institutional custody for Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin on the XRP Ledger and plans to extend its collateral-mirroring model to LMAX Group so institutions can post RLUSD as trading collateral while assets remain in the bank's custody.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Standard Chartered has rolled out institutional custody for Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin on the XRP Ledger and plans to extend its collateral-mirroring model to LMAX Group so institutions can post RLUSD as trading collateral while assets remain in the bank's custody.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Standard Chartered has rolled out institutional custody for Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin on the XRP Ledger and plans to extend its collateral-mirroring model to LMAX Group so institutions can post RLUSD as trading collateral while assets remain in the bank's custody.

updates.title_zh: 【渣打银行上线 RLUSD 托管服务，拟与 Ripple、LMAX 合作将 RLUSD 用作抵押品】
updates.title_en: 【渣打银行上线 RLUSD 托管服务，拟与 Ripple、LMAX 合作将 RLUSD 用作抵押品】
updates.what_changed_zh: 确认托管服务通过渣打银行受 DFSA 监管的 DIFC 分行提供，且将 RLUSD 作为 LMAX 产品合格抵押品仍需完成最终文件签署、测试、内部审批及监管准备等程序。
updates.what_changed_en: Confirmed the custody service is offered through Standard Chartered's DFSA-regulated DIFC branch, and that making RLUSD eligible collateral for LMAX products still requires final documentation, testing, internal approvals, and regulatory preparations.
updates.current_state_zh: 渣打银行已通过其受 DFSA 监管的 DIFC 分行上线 XRP Ledger 上 Ripple 稳定币 RLUSD 的机构托管服务，并正与 Ripple 及 LMAX Group 合作，计划以抵押品镜像模式将 RLUSD 用作 LMAX Group 指定产品的合格抵押品，但该功能仍需完成最终文件签署、测试、内部审批及监管准备等程序。
updates.current_state_en: Standard Chartered has launched institutional custody for Ripple's RLUSD on the XRP Ledger via its DFSA-regulated DIFC branch and is working with Ripple and LMAX Group to make RLUSD eligible collateral for selected LMAX products using a collateral-mirroring model, subject to final documentation, testing, internal approvals, and regulatory preparations.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Standard Chartered has begun offering institutional custody for Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin through its DFSA-regulated DIFC branch and is working with Ripple and LMAX Group to make RLUSD eligible collateral for selected LMAX products using a collateral-mirroring model.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Standard Chartered has begun offering institutional custody for Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin through its DFSA-regulated DIFC branch and is working with Ripple and LMAX Group to make RLUSD eligible collateral for selected LMAX products using a collateral-mirroring model.

updates.title_zh: ⚡️Ripple Prime向机构客户推出RWA永续合约，覆盖100多个市场
updates.title_en: ⚡️Ripple Prime向机构客户推出RWA永续合约，覆盖100多个市场
updates.what_changed_zh:
据彭博社10月15日报道，Ripple旗下主经纪商部门Ripple Prime正面向机构客户推出现实世界资产（RWA）永续合约，覆盖股票、指数、ETF、大宗商品等100多个参考市场。该产品通过Hyperliquid上的Trade.xyz提供，并支持跨仓位共享保证金，延续了Ripple Prime此前向客户开放加密永续合约交易的布局。

Ripple Prime国际首席执行官Michael Higgins表示，此举有助于机构提高资金使用和仓位管理效率。客户既可将永续合约与标的资产配对开展基差交易，也可利用合约进行方向性交易，在传统市场休市期间及周末获取相关资产敞口。

Higgins还表示，传统对冲基金已「非常接近」直接参与代币化RWA市场，关键在于建立符合其交易对手及反洗钱要求的基础设施。据报道，过去一年，数个主要交易平台的RWA永续合约未平仓规模已从接近零增至90亿美元。
updates.what_changed_en: Ripple's prime brokerage arm Ripple Prime rolled out institutional RWA perpetual contracts spanning 100+ stock, index, ETF and commodity markets through Hyperliquid-based Trade.xyz, offering shared cross-position margin and weekend/after-hours exposure.
updates.current_state_zh:
据彭博社10月15日报道，Ripple旗下主经纪商部门Ripple Prime正面向机构客户推出现实世界资产（RWA）永续合约，覆盖股票、指数、ETF、大宗商品等100多个参考市场。该产品通过Hyperliquid上的Trade.xyz提供，并支持跨仓位共享保证金，延续了Ripple Prime此前向客户开放加密永续合约交易的布局。

Ripple Prime国际首席执行官Michael Higgins表示，此举有助于机构提高资金使用和仓位管理效率。客户既可将永续合约与标的资产配对开展基差交易，也可利用合约进行方向性交易，在传统市场休市期间及周末获取相关资产敞口。

Higgins还表示，传统对冲基金已「非常接近」直接参与代币化RWA市场，关键在于建立符合其交易对手及反洗钱要求的基础设施。据报道，过去一年，数个主要交易平台的RWA永续合约未平仓规模已从接近零增至90亿美元。
updates.current_state_en: Ripple's prime brokerage arm Ripple Prime rolled out institutional RWA perpetual contracts spanning 100+ stock, index, ETF and commodity markets through Hyperliquid-based Trade.xyz, offering shared cross-position margin and weekend/after-hours exposure.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ripple's prime brokerage arm Ripple Prime rolled out institutional RWA perpetual contracts spanning 100+ stock, index, ETF and commodity markets through Hyperliquid-based Trade.xyz, offering shared cross-position margin and weekend/after-hours exposure.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ripple's prime brokerage arm Ripple Prime rolled out institutional RWA perpetual contracts spanning 100+ stock, index, ETF and commodity markets through Hyperliquid-based Trade.xyz, offering shared cross-position margin and weekend/after-hours exposure.
updates.background_zh: RWA永续合约是一种在链上追踪现实世界资产价格的永续期货。本次产品所依托的Trade.xyz在Hyperliquid上提供股票、指数、原油和外汇等永续合约交易。
updates.background_en: RWA perpetual contracts are perpetual futures that track real-world asset prices on-chain. Trade.xyz, the venue used for this rollout, lists stock, index, oil and FX perpetuals on Hyperliquid.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次推出将机构订单流引向链上永续合约平台——Hyperliquid与Trade.xyz——而该RWA永续合约板块过去一年在各主要平台的未平仓规模已增至约90亿美元。跨仓位共享保证金使抵押资金池与股票、指数、ETF及大宗商品敞口的关联更为直接，也使Ripple Prime的主经纪业务与其他上线代币化传统资产衍生品的平台形成并列竞争。
updates.market_impact_en: The launch routes institutional order flow toward on-chain perpetual venues — Hyperliquid and Trade.xyz — within an RWA perpetual segment whose open interest across major venues has grown to roughly $9 billion over the past year. Cross-position shared margin ties collateral pools more directly to equity, index, ETF and commodity exposure, placing Ripple Prime's brokerage offering alongside other venues listing tokenized traditional-asset derivatives.
